Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.passkeys

Class PasskeysPageController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.passkeys.PasskeysPageController
All Implemented Interfaces:
PasskeysPageApi
@Controller public class PasskeysPageController extends Object implements PasskeysPageApi
Renders the account page where the signed-in user registers passkeys. The registration itself is the WebAuthn ceremony of the security chain, driven by the script of the page; this page only lists what is registered.
